panels.caption: FIG. 7. (Color online) (a) FT-IR spectra of untreated nylon-6 nanofibers show almost no change after ZnO ALD coating, suggesting little chemical interaction of DEZ with the polyamide material. A subsequent glycidol/TMA MLD layer interacts with the carbonyl and amide modes, although no strong spectral difference is observed if an additional layer of Al2O3 follows the alucone, suggesting the MLD coating protects the nylon nanofibers from further degradation. (b) SEM images of the untreated nylon show that (c) degradation after TMA exposure is (d) minimized with the protective combination of ZnO and glycidol/ TMA coating. Reprinted with permission from Oldham et al ., J. Electrochem. Soc. 158 , D549 (2011). Copyright 2011, The Electrochemical Society.
